targets.name: dovecot-imap

scenarios.name: initial sync: exactly the 3 seeded messages, reply threaded (2 threads)
arrival: exactly one message.received and one thread.updated, with trust
search: full-text finds body text from the sync-time snippet
body: fetched on demand from the server and parsed
set_flags via the engine: one message.updated with before/after
flag change from another client arrives as message.updated
move via the engine to archive, then undo
set_folders: a message in two folders at once, then undo back to one
scenarios.note: both folders (2), then back to inbox, one id throughout

scenarios.name: tags: engine-owned tags set, searched, listed, scoped and undone
scenarios.note: set, found by tag and by text+tag, listed, invalid name rejected, removed, undone

scenarios.name: move from another client: one message.updated, no received, no deleted
scenarios.note: 419 ms out, 29571 ms back in, id stable

scenarios.name: expunge from another client: exactly one message.deleted
idempotency: same client_key returns the same action
propose -> approve: delete to trash only after approval, then undo
permanent delete: exactly one message.deleted
reject: a rejected proposal never touches the server
create_draft: lands in Drafts as a draft, threaded with its parent, then undone
attachments: listed on the message and downloadable byte for byte
scenarios.note: 2 listed, csv and 1 KB binary identical, index 9 is 404

scenarios.name: send: delivered to another mailbox, marked machine-sent, copy filed in Sent
schedule_timer: fires as timer.fired with the payload
flag storm: 25 flag changes from another client arrive as exactly 25 updates
tokens: scoped token sees only allowed types in allowed folders; propose_only writes queue; forbidden verbs 403
redaction: one-time codes and card numbers masked for the scoped token, raw for admin, snippet too
scenarios.note: masked for agent, raw for admin

scenarios.name: folder scope: a message moved out of the allowed folder disappears for the scoped token, and returns
publish: a plug-in token appends a derived event; core types reserved; non-publishers refused
scenarios.note: derived event stored with publisher name

scenarios.name: tokens: expired and deleted tokens are unauthorized
cursor log: strictly increasing, no gaps
offline catch-up: changes made while the engine was down arrive exactly once after restart

quirks: A message moved into the inbox by another client took 29571 ms to be noticed (server notifies late for mail copied into an already-seen state)
25 external flag changes delivered in 856 ms
Incremental sync: qresync; expunge detection: VANISHED
Folder model: folders; roles: archive=Archive, drafts=Drafts, inbox=INBOX, spam=Junk, sent=Sent, trash=Trash
